punchline: Two students with the same mild view of cheating face one temptation, and the reasons each gives afterward pull their beliefs far apart.
thirty_sec: Tavris describes two students who think about cheating the same way. A test matters for graduate school, both freeze on an essay question, and a neighbor's answers are in view. One copies, one looks away, and each then justifies the choice. Over time their beliefs drift far apart, like two people sliding down opposite sides of a pyramid they started at the top of.
